name: 22153 · Springfield, VA
findings: ZIP 22153 (Springfield) has 115 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22153 (Springfield) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
